## Play together

Practice plays locally. Invite a friend shares a code; the friend pastes it into
Join a friend and sends the displayed reply back. Set WEB_PAGE in some-project.dewy to
your hosted web build so native invitations can share a browser link.

For short room codes with no reply to copy, configure MATCH_SERVER in the source
or run `DEWY_MATCH_SERVER=ws://your-server:7700 ./main`. Browser pages accept
`?server=ws://your-server:7700`; HTTPS pages need a wss:// service. The Dewy
repository includes tools/compiler/rendezvous.jo and setup instructions in
examples/README.md. No public server is configured by default.

Keep some-project.dewy's filename the same in native and web builds: it is PROGRAM_NAME,
which scopes saved data and room names. Choose a distinct name before publishing.
The tick function consumes ordinary Game and Pad values; rollback replays it,
so keep clocks, live input and unseeded randomness outside it.
